assertions.evidence: In src/urgency.ts, buildUrgencyRequest defines questions.urgency with type: "score" and a five-item ordered criteria array; test/urgency.test.ts also asserts the question is a score with 5 levels.
In src/urgency.ts, toUrgencyRating derives urgency in code as (Math.round(answer.score) + 1), and README.md states the API returns 0–4 and code rounds and adds one; no second call is made.
buildUrgencyRequest sets state to { service: input.service.trim(), report: input.text.trim() }, and test/urgency.test.ts verifies request.state equals { service: "api", report: "outage" }.
